$comment: Abstention on the 79 unanswerable gold-set questions (#1463), read from the per-case rows of the two identical run-A artifacts that v1-baseline.json already registers. No new run: a fresh gold-set run opens the live vault (Vault.init records the vault root outside the vault) and was not allowed in this round. This is a SECONDARY ANALYSIS of existing rows, not the preregistered follow-up run the issue asks for; the open cells are listed under `not_measured`.

source_runs.command: BASTRA_VAULT_PATH=<vault> npx tsx src/goldset-run.ts --gold <12 gold files> --hybrid --gate --out <file>
source_runs.arm: Hybrid (BM25 + Vector RRF), ollama embeddinggemma, store copied from vault

definitions.population: main denominator 663 = 79 no_answer + 584 answerable; the 36 probe cases are excluded, as in v1-baseline
definitions.mcp_path: MCP `recall` applies no evidence gate (tool-defs-memory.ts). Its only absence signals are: nothing above the score floor (`abstained`), and `weak_result`, which exists only on the hybrid path
definitions.hook_path: The hook path drops every hit the evidence decision marks `no_answer` (hook-recall-evidence.ts, gate on by default). `gate silent` = the decision kept no hit (required + optional = 0) for the case. The runner computes the decision with `decideHits` the way the daemon does, but unscoped (`scope: null`), which makes `required` rarer than in a scoped hook call
definitions.mandatory_load: a case where the decision marked at least one hit `required`

results.reading: On this gold set Recall almost never says 'I don't have it'. Without the gate (MCP path) 0 of 79 unanswerable questions come back empty and weak_result flags 1 of 79. With the gate (hook path) the hook stays silent on 2 of 79 and marks at least one hit as must-load on 14 of 79. The gate costs 2 of 584 answerable questions.

not_measured: BM25-only arm (no embedding model), gate on and off: no artifact exists; weak_result is undefined there
the shipped code: the evidence decision changed after 8c6bdcb0 (6dea17f5 Unicode case folding, b384354e identifier anchor), so these figures describe the September predicate
the full hook pipeline (scope, band assignment, budget) beyond the evidence decision on the k=10 pool
